description: Orvi wears a dark navy knee-length noble tunic with intricate gold geometric tablet-woven borders around the split neckline, central front, cuffs and lower hem. Cream linen appears at the collar and wrists. A textured blue-green shoulder cloak with gold geometric borders and a fringed edge crosses his chest and drapes from his left shoulder, fastened by one round ornate gold-toned brooch. A broad brown leather belt has circular plaques and a long embellished hanging strap. Brown trousers, patterned woven leg wraps and brown leather ankle boots complete the outfit. Both hands hang naturally at his sides. His auburn hair is uncovered; there is no armor, weapon or crown.
